pr.title: fix(chat): keep image Read results non-collapsible
pr.body:
## Fix
Read rows currently offer a disclosure toggle for image results. Set `isCollapsible={!isImage}` only on the Read arm, using the last lowercased extension and an own-property check against the nine recorded image extensions. Text-file disclosure, file opening, statuses, and tool result bytes remain unchanged.

Add the frozen 28-case fixture and its byte-identical input file. The constructor control remains unchanged. The parity basis is the retained Conductor 0.87.6 REA packet, evidence `ev_410f83a50764142c952de5f040cde338700477289c1687932071bdc5427c84b2`, not a new native observation.

## Verification
Conductor Rebuild ran these commands once on Cloud355 against main `09b1c998`, with #1198's exact two-source-file change separately qualified. The original fixture, inputs, patch, freeze, dependency lock, and 29 protected bindings were preserved.

Baseline and candidate used the identical command:


```bash
env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=768 nice -n 19 timeout --kill-after=5s 180s node --max-old-space-size=768 --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 src/features/chat/readImageDisclosure.test.ts
```

- Before: exit 1, exactly 12 intended disclosure assertion failures and 16 passing controls. No crashes, skips, or cancellations. The constructor control passed.
- After the exact sealed Read-arm patch: exit 0, all 28 passed, including constructor.

Retained adjacent checks passed, exit 0, all 50 top-level cases. The remount checks also verified their historical five-case baseline and current five-case candidate:

```bash
env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=768 nice -n 19 timeout --kill-after=5s 180s node --max-old-space-size=768 --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 src/features/chat/readSyntaxHighlight.test.ts src/features/chat/conductorTools.test.ts src/features/chat/disclosureRemount.test.ts src/features/chat/imageGenerationFallbackDisclosure.test.ts
```

Typecheck passed, exit 0:

```bash
env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1024 nice -n 19 timeout --kill-after=5s 180s npm run typecheck
```

The local checkpoint contains exactly the product patch and the two unchanged fixture copies. The complete run took 75.18 seconds within its 930-second bound; the slot was explicitly released with no jobs, zombies, or servers remaining. [Original receipt, phase events, and qualified source binding](https://reasonmachines.com/agents/d7b27c48-81c4-4bc8-9c2c-8eb81996b477) are attached in the owning Session.

## Limits
No browser or native execution, screenshot, package build, release dispatch, or containing-package verification ran in this dependency-ordered unit. There is no screenshot because the grant excludes browser/native work; mounted component assertions are not native parity proof. COPY26, empty-review disclosure, and normalization changes are excluded. Package and native verification remain with the existing serialized release owner.

fix(chat): retain typed subagent results on errors

Conductor Rebuild forwards the original result to typed Task/Agent rows, retaining Formatted/Raw/copy disclosure on failures. Remove only the resulting pure dead MoreRows output binding; the separate Row binding, other arms, parsers and links are unchanged. Frozen sixteen-case RED reproduced two intended failures and fourteen passing controls, identical GREEN passed sixteen, five named sibling suites passed seventy-two. Initial tsc found TS6133; separately admitted corrective tsc passed after the reconciled dead-binding deletion. Evidence records both results and all original-byte hashes. No tests were weakened or rerun beyond serialized grants. Native/provider/package/deployment behavior is unverified; fixed992 release ownership and cut unchanged.

fix(chat): reject inherited file glyph extensions

Conductor Rebuild restricts the extension registry lookup to own properties. The focused fixture reproduces constructor and __proto__ tuple crashes before the correction and passes all six cases afterward. The original frozen constructor control also passes unchanged.

Adjacent local coverage timed out after 39 passing subtests; local typecheck was not run after that stop. Full disclosure, COPY26, browser, native and package verification are not claimed. Exact evidence and limits are retained.
